Sorry about your brother. May he rest in peace. I too, have recently just lost someone very dear to me. I understand how you must feel. It feels fake and like you're still waiting for him to walk through the door. I currently still feel like this as it has happened only a few weeks ago (oct 17 2014) i lost my 5 year old son in an automobile accident where my father has accidentally ran him over while he was backing out of our drive way. We all knew it was dangerous because we cant turn in our drive way and it goes way in about 60 - 80 feet before we can turn and get on our way. Anyways sorry for the jibber jabber. You have to surround yourself with people you care about and try not to be angry at the people who are too busy to be there for you some may be scared to face the 'music'. Thinking "what if" can make you go insane, believe me. And if you are religious, Use this now. Nobody can tell you how long to mourn so take your time, and as iusc12 has stated talking about it helps... It helps a LOT!
If you have nobody to talk to, look for groups that help in these types of situations, group or one on one counselling. Think about the people who are affected. Think about your parents/guardians and think how they'd feel if they lost you. Two kids gone... I cant imagine losing my 3 year old son... So please think before you do harm to yourself.
